mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening labor market and reduced consumer spending, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises and RSAFS falls, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 in a 3-month window, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90.0 for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with a weakening labor market, which together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakness
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 350000), strong retail sales support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 350000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
